records.source: 工房のお姉さんファンたちが{j}心血を注いだ防具。可憐さと{j}妖艶さの共演はアートの領域。
records.previous: Armor into which the Workshop lady's fans poured{j}their heart and soul. The pairing of cuteness and{j}seductive allure is a work of art.
records.target: Armor funded by Workshop lady fans.{j}Its cute and alluring design is{j}a work of art.

records.source: 安らぎに満ちた冥暗の胴防具。{j}これを得た者には安息を与え、{j}進化させるという噂がある。
records.previous: Body Armor of gloom filled with tranquility.{j}It is said to grant repose to those who obtain it, and{j}to cause them to evolve.
records.target: Body armor of tranquil gloom.{j}Said to grant repose to its bearer and{j}cause them to evolve.

records.source: 遠方の工房より伝来した胴用{j}装備。断熱性に優れた特殊な{j}素材が使用され汎用性が高い。
records.previous: {j}armor for the Body passed down from a distant workshop. Uses a special{j}material with excellent insulation, making it highly versatile.
records.target: {j}Body armor from a distant workshop.{j}Insulating material makes it versatile.

records.source: ”天”を翔ける雄火竜と”地”{j}を引き裂く雌火竜の魂が”人”{j}の技にて転生せし胴防具。
records.previous: Body Armor in which the souls of the male Fire Wyvern that soars through the heavens and the female Fire Wyvern that tears the earth{j}were reincarnated through human{j}skill.
records.target: Body armor reborn through human craft,{j}holding souls of the male Fire Wyvern of{j}heaven and female of earth.

records.source: 大巌竜の素材を用いた胴防具。{j}幾多の困難をくぐり抜けた者{j}は覇者の称号こそ相応しい。
records.previous: Body Armor made from Great Boulder Dragon materials.{j}Those who have weathered countless{j}hardships are truly worthy of a champion's title.
records.target: Body armor made from Great Boulder Dragon.{j}Those who weather countless hardships{j}deserve a champion's title.

records.source: エスピナス希少種の特徴を参{j}考にして作成された、聴覚保護{j}特化ガンナー用胴防具。
records.previous: Created with reference{j}to the traits of the Espinas Rare Species, this body armor is for Gunners specialized in Hearing Protection{j}.
records.target: Body armor for Hearing Protection Gunners{j}based on Espinas Rare Species traits.{j}Built for specialized hearing protection.

records.source: 赤闘獣の紅毛や極鉄など素材{j}で生産した重厚な胴防具。{j}精巧な金属細工が美しい。
records.previous: Heavy Body armor crafted from{j}materials such as the Red Violent Beast's crimson fur and extreme iron.{j}Its intricate metalwork is beautiful.
records.target: Heavy body armor of crimson fur and iron.{j}Crafted from Red Violent Beast materials.{j}Beautiful intricate metalwork.

records.source: 大巌竜の素材を用いた胴用{j}防具。更なる進化を求める{j}狩人達を守る究極の鉄壁。
records.previous: Body{j}Armor made from the Great Rock Wyvern's materials. The ultimate iron wall, protecting the{j}Hunters who seek further evolution.
records.target: Body{j}armor of Great Rock Wyvern materials.{j}An iron wall for Hunters seeking growth.

records.source: 街を守護するという騎士の、{j}腕用装備の廉価版。華美な{j}部分を廃した質実剛健な作り。
records.previous: A budget version of the{j}arm gear worn by knights sworn to guard the city. Sturdy and practical, stripped of all{j}ornamentation.
records.target: Budget arm gear for knights guarding the{j}town. Sturdy and practical, with all{j}ornamentation removed.

records.source: お店の女性スタッフ用制服の{j}同型品。繊細な作業にも邪魔{j}にならない手袋がポイント。
records.previous: The same model{j}as the shop's female staff uniform. The gloves that never get in the way{j}even during delicate work are the key point.
records.target: The shop's female staff uniform model.{j}Its gloves never hinder delicate work;{j}that is its key feature.

scope: Ten exact-source body- and arm-armor description patterns.
